classification: read-only MAC-only source-correction architecture planning after validated evidence attempt 9 blocker
objective: Derive one minimal, implementable, control-pack-consistent contract for canonical manifest-bound pre-Stage-1 Linux guest artifact production, retention, and admission, without changing source or native state.
mandatory_questions: Reconcile the current installer-to-publisher-bootstrap-to-Stage-1 ordering and name the exact source-owned call sequence.

Distinguish the host macOS executor evidence currently constructed as ExecutorBuildEvidenceV1 from the externally built Linux guest executor and runtime artifacts; do not overload or fabricate either identity.

Re-derive the exact required artifact role set. In particular, determine the disposition of mac.lima.guest-binary(world), because the current Cargo graph exposes world only as a library and no world binary target.

Define the closed typed bundle, fixed roles, source/build/toolchain/digest/physical-identity joins, no-follow staging, atomicity, retry, rollback, and root-owned retained provenance needed before Stage-1.

Define how the canonical installer obtains or produces the external artifacts without a generic path selector and how direct publisher-bootstrap returns the signed Stage-1 authorization before lima-warm consumes it.
Produce the exact implementation path/symbol fence, TDD matrix, causal review gates, and evidence retry command sequence.
required_invariants: MAC-only correction; no Windows, WSL, or ordinary Linux-host behavior changes.
Linux changes, if any, are limited to the exact aarch64 Lima guest artifact build/entrypoint closure and must not change ordinary Linux-host lifecycle behavior.
No generic artifact selector, caller-chosen role/path, manual prefix copy, ambient discovery, alternate endpoint, transport, principal, instance, or bootstrap route.

External builds remain nonce-scoped, exact-source, locked/offline, target-bound, and outside the attached source mirror; staged prefix files are fixed-role regular no-follow artifacts with digest and physical-identity joins.
The current singular ExecutorBuildEvidenceV1 must not silently stand for both the host macOS executor and multiple Linux guest artifacts.
Do not invent a world executable or alias another binary under that role; either prove its real source/consumer and producer or propose an explicit reviewed role-set correction.
The canonical installer, direct publisher bootstrap, signed Stage-1 authorization, and lima-warm ordering must be executable without a trust gap or circular prerequisite.
No product, test, runtime-refactor, review-control, Cargo, lockfile, or orchestration source edit in this planning packet.
authorized_actions: read exact source and runtime-refactor control pack
read attempt-9 artifact, receipt, discovery, and blocker records
run GitNexus read-only queries/impact with manual exact-source fallback
run cargo metadata and non-mutating external-target feasibility probes in a nonce-scoped temporary directory
spawn fresh read-only reviewers for authority/security, lifecycle/convergence, and allowlist/evidence review
return one structured planning receipt to meta
prohibited_actions: any repository edit, stage, commit, push, reset, clean, rebase, merge, archive, or target-ref mutation
installer execution, prefix staging, /Library, Keychain, launchd, Lima, sudoers, known_hosts, code-signing, pairing, lifecycle, retirement, native evidence, or closeout mutation
manual copying of the attempt-9 external executor artifact into the prefix

review.required: fresh read-only three-lens audit of the proposed implementation contract
review.terminal: PLANNED_CLEAN only if no unresolved P1/P2 contradiction remains
